text:
carmen: quick sync: we want the signer pod to call KMS for cosign during the base-image rebuild. proposing very narrow role: crypto.sign on projects/redwood-prod/.../signer-key only.

dina: paste the policy snippet? we need to be sure it can't list or get other keys.

carmen: draft: { Role: projects/redwood-prod/roles/kmsImageSigner, Permissions: [cloudkms.cryptoSign], Resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-key }

lee: add an IAM condition restricting access to the signer workload identity and to requests coming from the rebuild namespace.

dina: also ensure signer attaches AAD with image and build_id so audit logs tie back to repo. audit-bot will check logs.

ops-bot: deploy: signer-v1 PR #4218 created. includes seccomp profile and readOnlyRootFilesystem.

dina: alerting: add metric signer.sign.error rate > 0.5% => slack-alert, >1/hr => pager. owner: carmen, backstop: lee.

carmen: will do. vuln-scan: canary images will be scanned; will post SBOM link into PR.

lee: keep offline GPG escrow for rollback signing; log entries must include cosign transparency proof.

audit-bot: note: Cloud Audit will emit CryptoKeyAccess entries; ensure principal is the signer SA and AAD fields are present.

carmen: thanks. merging PR after Dina approves IAM condition change.

dina: approving once condition added. :thumbsup:

carmen: thanks, closing thread.
